purpose: 来源合格后，在读取股票标签和拟合前登记唯一审批字段、原固定模型及完整裁决；保存完整实际执行程序。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,copy
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_joint_score_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def receipt(rel):
 p=ROOT/rel;assert p.is_file(),'登记输入不存在：'+rel
 return {'path':rel,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def readj(rel):return json.loads((ROOT/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert not (OUT/'protocol.json').exists() and not (OUT/'result.json').exists(),'不得覆盖已登记研究'
old=readj('reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1/protocol.json')
gate_rel='reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1/source_gate.json'
gate=readj(gate_rel)
assert gate['source_gate_passed'] and gate['current_named_values_qualified']==29 and gate['known_original_members']==1711 and gate['complete_current_and_original_mature_pools']==1212
prior=readj('reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1/result.json')
assert prior['status']=='REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_BANKERS_OVERALL_LOAN_DEMAND_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT'
plan=copy.deepcopy(old['fixed_model_plan'])
plan['added_features']=['银行贷款审批指数']
plan['added_definition']='唯一已公布本季银行贷款审批指数原百分数0—100；审批条件放松回答占比×1+基本不变回答占比×0.5。未用贷款需求字段、差分、同比、变号、季节模型或信息龄预测列。是受访银行主观松紧感受，非实际获批率、纯外生供给冲击、指数流入或精确预期差。'
source_paths=[gate_rel,
 'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1/全部29当前审批字段_原表头季度行及方法.json',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1/原八字段与银行审批_未读股票标签.parquet',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1/全部1711原成员_审批当时公开信息.csv',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1/全部1212原评分日_审批全成熟池支持.csv',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1/03_同一2020Q4审批原页目视核对.json',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1/实际旧字段用途资格.json']
proto={
 'study_id':'510300_BANK_LOAN_APPROVAL_CONDITION_FIXED_NINE_FIELD_JOINT_SCORE_V1',
 'experiment_id':'E81','registered_at':now(),
 'status':'REGISTERED_ONE_ORIGINAL_BANK_APPROVAL_FIELD_FIXED_JOINT_SCORE_BEFORE_RETURN_LABEL_USE',
 'hypothesis':'银行贷款审批条件的不同已知主观状态，可能改变原订单/资金价格/融资/趋势/波动联合条件的剩余五日净收益估计。它与贷款需求是不同原问题，但共享受访银行根来源；不预设线性符号，不识别纯外生原因。',
 'previous_studies_preserved':['E80审批原字段仅来源资格成立，不是经济结果','E78贷款需求固定表达拒绝、E79主期零费用信号仍负','E76超额准备金率来源未通过、E17晚版本拒绝','原八变量及价格/采购/生产/就业/服务等全部失败'],
 'source_gate':gate_rel,'source_original_quarters':29,
 'source_claim':'同一29当季原报告表头/当前季度行/编制方法/显示公开钟全齐，1711成员和1212原成熟池支持全齐；未见已知晚版本。仅保守历史重构，真正首版/首次公开与独立验证未认证。',
 'fixed_model_plan':plan,'parents':[receipt(x['path']) for x in old['parents']],
 'source_stage_outputs':[receipt(x) for x in source_paths],
 'economic_candidates':1,'parameters_changed_from_original_control':False,
 'new_tree_fits_budget':1212,'new_ridge_comparator_fits_budget':1212,'baseline_refits_budget':0,
 'new_stock_labels_budget':0,'new_accounts_budget':0,'source_code_edits_budget':0,'parameter_grids':0,
 'decision':'五项原主期门全过才另登记完整20万主/2万敏感性账户；否则该固定审批表达拒绝，只解释全部原机会信号/费用/路径。不更换审批字段表达、阈值、符号、持有期、时期或费用营救。',
 'independent_validation':'NOT_ESTABLISHED_ALREADY_OBSERVED_HISTORY','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
 'market_expectation_surprise':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','bank_approval_causal_equity_effect':'NOT_IDENTIFIED',
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'only_executable_assets':['510300.SH','CASH_CNY'],'orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False,
 'target_net_sharpe':1.2,'target_net_cagr':0.1,'target_max_drawdown':0.1,
 'annualization_sessions':242,'minimum_naturally_completed_cycles_per_full_year':5
}
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(proto,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'已登记':proto['study_id'],'原字段':plan['added_features'],'贷款需求字段加入':False,'来源全齐':True,'一次固定拟合预算':2424,'新标签及账户预算':0,'源码修改':0},ensure_ascii=False))
